title: HOC Composition
description: Learn how to compose multiple HOCs together.

data.text: You can compose multiple HOCs to combine their behaviors. This is useful for adding multiple cross-cutting concerns to a component.

data.title: Manual

data.text: The `compose` utility (from Redux or Lodash) makes composition more readable.

data.title: compose

data.text: Modern React often uses hooks instead of HOCs for composition.

data.title: Hooks vs HOCs
Modern Preference
data.text: Hooks are generally preferred over HOCs in modern React. They avoid wrapper hell and are easier to compose.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Compose multiple HOCs for combined behavior
